ROY.availability: Strictly negative fitted weight per raw game below ceil(85% of team regular-season games). Multi-team rows use season maximum schedule, flagged as an approximation.
ROY.standardization: Within-season candidate-pool z scores except games_below_threshold, which uses raw uncentered game counts.
